title: Microtune
description: Microtuning on the 12 audio tracks: SETTINGS > TUNING picks a factory tuning (just intonation, Pythagorean, meantone, well temperaments, Arabic Rast, Poole ROD12), SETTINGS > TUNE ROOT its root. Kept across power-off. Needs a core with ST_NATIVE_PITCH (host API 21; prototype 2.9.0-mt1).
author: Safie Flato (steveflato)
